passA.contextIsolation: Legacy scores, critiques, tags, Overall Commentary, and AI Extension were excluded from the benchmark definition.

passB.contextIsolation: Pass B used the same active model task and therefore had only procedural, not contextual, separation from Pass A.

passIndependence.limitation: Both passes were produced by 5.6 Sol in one active task. The benchmark inputs withheld legacy scores, critiques, tags, and commentary, but the passes were not context-independent. Agreement statistics therefore test mechanics and judgment repeatability only; they are not inter-rater reliability evidence.
